entry.title: GPP Link 1.2.0
entry.summary: GPP Link 1.2.0 — the RECEIVED tab New: RECEIVED tab (cassette side B) - See everything your MPC has received: the files in From Computer, newest first, with a files-received counter - Turn Received and press PLAY to hear a received beat on the cassette (your computer converts it; nothing is kept there) - SEND TO FOLDER and SEND TO GET PRODUCERS PAID on this tab send the received beat - Load received beats in the MPC browser: MPC User > From Computer New look - The bars on the cassette bounce to

entry.title: GPP Link 1.1.0
entry.summary: GPP Link 1.1.0 — now with the MPC Sample New: MPC SAMPLE GPP The MPC Sample has no Wi-Fi, so it connects with a USB-C cable. Just plug and send. - Put a microSD card in the MPC Sample, turn on SD Card Access (Project page) and plug it into your computer - Open http://localhost:47800 and pick the card's drive once in the MPC SAMPLE GPP box - Send to MPC Sample: any beat from your Beats folder goes to MPC-Sample/Samples/GPP Link - Send Folder to MPC Sample: whole sample packs, kits and stems, fold

entry.title: GPP Link 1.0.0
entry.summary: GPP Link 1.0.0 — first release Send beats over Wi-Fi between your MPC (or Force), the Beats folder on your computer, and Get Producers Paid.
